summary: Veru Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register up to $21.8 million of common stock for an at-the-market offering under a Sales Agreement with Oppenheimer and Canaccord. The shares are sold at prevailing market prices ($3.16 on July 1, 2026) with a 3.0% commission. This is a routine equity shelf takedown, not a special situation. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No change of control, premium, or strategic catalyst.
